name: {{projectName}}
description: Full-stack workspace: FastAPI API with a React, Vue, or Svelte Vite client, wired to PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 3000
scripts.db:push: cd server && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "migration"
scripts.db:seed: cd server && uv run python -m app.seed
